title: The insult
disclaimer: Adult-stark. The wound is consequence, not spectacle. No gore close-up as titillation.
story_goal: Lakshmana rejects her; the mutilation (nose/ears) is consequence, not spectacle; she flees cursing.
framework_goal: Adult violence without gore-porn; continuity of her face before vs after.
gate: Two Surpanakha sheets (whole / wounded); you signed the violence line.
narrative_summary: The second refusal turns to a blade. She leaves wounded. The ashram light does not change.

palette: blood as a small fact not a flood

fact_checks.claim: Lakshmana cuts Surpanakha's nose and ears after the refusal.
fact_checks.source_note: Aranya Kanda. We do not linger on tissue.

panels.scene_description: Whole Surpanakha still. She reaches for Lakshmana as if the redirect were consent.
panels.dialogue:
SURPANAKHA: If he is closed, you are not.
LAKSHMANA: I did not offer.

shot_card.camera: medium two-shot, her hand on his wrap
shot_card.blocking: she closes; he turns his shoulder

panels.scene_description: His blade is out. Not a flourish. A decision already made.
panels.dialogue: LAKSHMANA: Do not put your mouth on this house.

shot_card.camera: close on blade and his eyes; her face still whole at edge of frame

panels.scene_description: The cut has happened. We see her after: blood, shock, ruined midface. Eyes still hers. No anatomy lesson.
panels.caption: It is done. That is the whole of the spectacle.

shot_card.camera: medium, three-quarter, not a medical insert
shot_card.blocking: she staggers; hands at the wound, not posed

panels.scene_description: Ashram: Rama has stood. Sita's hand on the doorpost. They are not cheering.
panels.dialogue:
SITA: That will travel.
RAMA: It already has.

shot_card.camera: medium ashram, same architecture as ep01-p01
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: House does not get a pass.

panels.scene_description: She screams at him. Words of kin and Lanka, not a cartoon hex.
panels.dialogue:
SURPANAKHA: My brothers will unmake your names.
LAKSHMANA: Then send them.

shot_card.lighting: her blood catches the key; do not glorify it

panels.scene_description: She runs into Dandaka. Wounded face in profile. Trees like bars.
panels.caption: She does not go to die. She goes to tell.

shot_card.blocking: exit into forest, same path language as ep01-p08

panels.scene_description: Lakshmana wipes the blade. His wrap is the identity lock. He does not smile.
Three at the ashram as light dies one notch. The hut is the same. The story is not.
